page: Running Hono on Bun JavaScript runtime with TypeScript and JSX support. Installation: follow bun.com official instructions. Setup new project: bun create hono@latest my-app, bun install. Add to existing project: bun add hono, configure package.json dev script. Hello World: standard Hono app with export default. Run development: bun run dev, access http://localhost:3000. Port configuration: export default { port: 3000, fetch: app.fetch }. Static files: serveStatic from 'hono/bun' with root option. Options: rewriteRequestPath for path mapping, mimes for MIME types, onFound/onNotFound for callbacks, precompressed for gzip/brotli checking. Testing: bun:test framework with describe, expect, it. Run tests: bun test file. Questions: How do I set up Hono on Bun? How do I serve static files? How do I configure the port? How do I test?

sections.manifest: Bun installation and setup. Install Bun: follow official bun.com instructions. New project: bun create hono@latest my-app, cd my-app, bun install. Existing project: bun add hono, add dev script to package.json. Starter template available at github.com/honojs/starter/templates/bun. Questions: How do I install Bun? How do I create new project? How do I add to existing project?

Hello World application on Bun. File: src/index.ts. Code: standard Hono with import, app.get(), export default app. Similar to other platforms. bun run dev expects src/index.ts. Run: bun run dev, access http://localhost:3000. TypeScript and JSX support without separate transpiling. Questions: What's the basic setup? How do I run dev server?

Static file serving with serveStatic. Import from 'hono/bun'. Configuration: root path, path for specific files. Usage: app.use('/static/*', serveStatic({...})). Catch-all: app.get('*', serveStatic({path: '...'})) for fallback. Favicon: app.use('/favicon.ico', serveStatic({path: './favicon.ico'})). Directory structure: separate static folder. Questions: How do I serve static files? How do I handle favicon? How do I set fallback?

serveStatic options. rewriteRequestPath: function mapping paths, e.g., '/static' to '/statics'. mimes: custom MIME type mapping { m3u8: 'application/vnd.apple.mpegurl', ts: 'video/mp2t' }. onFound: callback when file found, e.g., set Cache-Control header. onNotFound: callback when file not found, logs path. precompressed: checks for .br/.gz files, serves based on Accept-Encoding, priority Brotli > Zstd > Gzip. Questions: How do I rewrite paths? How do I add MIME types? How do I handle cache headers? How do I add compression?

Testing with bun:test framework. Imports: describe, expect, it from 'bun:test'. Test structure: describe('name', () => { it('should...', async () => {...}) }). Example: new Request, app.fetch(req), expect(res.status).toBe(200). Run tests: bun test file.test.ts. Questions: How do I write tests? What's bun:test? How do I run tests?

Port configuration. Default: http://localhost:3000. Custom port: export default { port: number, fetch: app.fetch } instead of export default app. Access: http://localhost:<port>. Questions: How do I change port? What's the default port? How do I export with port?
